fx.unit: INR per 1 USD (positive shock = rupee depreciation)

targets.source_name: OECD Main Economic Indicators via FRED
targets.unit: percent, year-over-year change of CPI (all items)
targets.observation_definition: Monthly CPI index (2015=100); year-over-year % computed by this pipeline as (index_t / index_t-12 - 1) * 100
targets.publication_lag_or_availability_rule: Assumed known one month after its reference month (conservative; the OECD/FRED copy may appear later)
targets.notes: Source is an index, so YoY is computed here (not double-differenced). The FRED copy of this OECD series was seen to end in early 2025 when checked - see last_observation in data/source_metadata.csv after download.

targets.source_name: IMF International Financial Statistics via FRED
targets.observation_definition: IMF IFS 'Discount Rate' for India, monthly value as published
targets.publication_lag_or_availability_rule: Policy rate changes are public immediately; value for month t treated as known at end of month t
targets.notes: PROXY, NOT THE REPO RATE. Values seen while checking the catalogue (4.25 in Mar 2022; 5.15 in Jun-Jul 2022) are consistent with the RBI Bank Rate (repo + 0.25) - this is an inference, verify against RBI. The FRED copy appeared to stop around Jul 2022 when checked. For a true repo series supply data/raw/manual/rbi_repo_rate_monthly.csv.

targets.source_name: OECD Main Economic Indicators via FRED
targets.unit: percent per annum (10-year government bond yield)
targets.observation_definition: OECD long-term (10-year) government bond yield, monthly. Averaging convention (monthly average vs end-of-month) NOT verified - confirm in OECD metadata
targets.publication_lag_or_availability_rule: Treated as known at end of its reference month
targets.notes: Coverage seen in the FRED vintage catalogue: Dec 2011 onward. Single maturity (10y) only.

targets.observation_definition: End-of-month RBI policy repo rate as entered by the user (CSV columns: month_end, repo_rate_pct)
targets.publication_lag_or_availability_rule: Repo changes are announced immediately; end-of-month value known at end of month
targets.notes: OPTIONAL. Skipped automatically if the CSV is absent. No automated RBI download was verified, so no repo data is bundled or invented.

excluded_targets.reason: No India-specific monthly import-price series could be verified on FRED. Only import VALUE (USD) series were found, which are not prices. Not substituted.
